summary: The registrant eXoZymes Inc. filed an 8-K to disclose entry into a Placement Agent Agreement for an underwritten offering of 35,555 units at $18.00 per unit, each consisting of two shares and one warrant, with gross proceeds of $639,990. The offering closed on the same day, June 30, 2026. This is a routine capital-raising transaction under an existing shelf registration statement, with proceeds earmarked for business development and working capital. There are no special-situation elements such as a tender offer, going-private transaction, or restructuring. The filing solely reports a standard securities placement without any vote, board recommendation, or strategic review, so no special-situation classification applies.
